_about: The course calendar (assets/schedule.js on the site, worker.js in the bot). One lesson per study day, Monday to Friday, in 'order'; each opens at 00:00 Tashkent time and its homework closes at 23:59 on its due day: the same day, or the later lesson 'due' names (the plan's due days). 'start' = the first study day (YYYY-MM-DD); null = no schedule, everything open. 'dates' pins a lesson to its own day outside the walk (Day 0 on the Friday before). 'off' = days without a lesson: every later lesson moves one study day on. The practice day is never scheduled.
